europe_now.title: Black Sea Drone Attack
europe_now.summary: Seven crew members are missing after a drone attack left a tanker ablaze off the coast of Romania. The incident highlights escalating regional security concerns regarding Black Sea maritime routes.

sources.headline: Seven missing off Romania after latest Black Sea drone attacks

europe_now.title: Albanian Student Protests
europe_now.summary: Anti-government protests in Albania have escalated as students rampage through the capital and defy leadership calls. The unrest resulted in the looting and burning of the College of Europe campus.

sources.headline: Albania's leader defies calls to resign as student protesters rampage in capital

top_stories.title: EU Budget and Policy Negotiations
top_stories.summary: European leaders are navigating intense debates over budgetary allocations and strategic policy timelines. French President Emmanuel Macron has warned that leaders must reach an agreement on the budget before the end of the year.

sources.headline: Shorten EU budget to 3 or 4 years, Cyprus president tells POLITICO
Macron warns EU leaders they need to agree budget by end of year

top_stories.title: Ukraine Conflict and Energy Strikes
top_stories.summary: Ukraine has resumed military strikes on Russian oil refineries as a key leverage point for future peace talks. Meanwhile, European officials continue to address winter energy supply security and strategic reserves.
